operations.title: S2 Infrastructure Unification: Metadata Handling and Production Readiness
operations.content: The S2 infrastructure consolidation centers on unified write paths and production-ready metadata handling. remember() silently dropped extra fields since April 13 (id:d95fb32a) — fixed through unified _store_node_metadata() (id:c9f0d394). The _sys_ prefix convention separates system metadata from user content (id:140a9fa0). Unified archive_node() provides single archive path with edge/vector cleanup (id:0fd3f6e1). S2 decoder overlap check prevents duplicate clusters with 60% threshold (id:f62b7a12). S2CE per-type quotas enable mixed proposal types per idle cycle (id:4c103b3c). S2CE minified proposal format achieved 93% token reduction per batch (id:ea7bd0b2). Dashboard missing S2 healer visibility needs fixing (id:4eb86b29). The pattern: every production issue traced to dual write paths or metadata inconsistency. Lesson: infrastructure unification prevents silent failures, not just operational friction.
operations.situation: When implementing S2 production features — use unified write paths, separate system metadata with _sys_ prefix, prevent overlapping proposals through thresholds

operations.title: Recall Pipeline Architecture: From Query Expansion to Precision Loops
operations.content: The recall pipeline flows: query → vocab expand → embed → intent → scale (id:ee205f63). But mark_recall_used() missing breaks the precision loop, killing Hebbian reinforcement (id:bf618356). 15 except:pass blocks hide all failures from operator visibility (id:1633932e). Critical unknowns: How should mark_recall_used determine which recalled nodes count? (id:8a8f9bbc) How to pass _recall_log_id from pre-response hook to post-response? (id:8166f7d0). The pattern: recall architecture complete on paper, broken in practice through missing feedback loops. The precision system depends on usage tracking for quality improvement — without mark_recall_used(), recalls don't learn from success/failure. Silent failures prevent diagnosis. This is infrastructure debt masquerading as feature gaps.
operations.situation: When working on recall pipeline — prioritize feedback loops and error visibility over new features, usage tracking enables learning
operations.keywords: recall pipeline query expansion vocab embed intent scale mark_recall_used precision loop Hebbian reinforcement
operations.community_narrative: Complete architectural design → missing feedback infrastructure → silent failure cascade → precision learning disabled. Architecture without observability is technical debt.

operations.title: S2 Community Detection Debugging: From Cold Start Chaos to State-Based Logic
operations.content: S2 _last_run_timestamp used wrong SQL — no unit filter, no delta trace (id:5b8e39e9). The success check lesson: missing delta trace = incomplete run, not success (id:10db439b). State-based community detection: process nodes without edges, not timestamps (id:dd301b34). 76 duplicate communities from April 15 cold start had to be archived manually (id:c46084ff). brain_batch crash on malformed LLM operations requires type guard fixes (id:ce8d9aef). The pattern: S2 cold start revealed systematic state tracking failures. Every debugging session uncovered another assumption about state persistence that proved wrong. The shift to state-based logic (nodes without edges) represents learning: timestamps lie, state doesn't. Manual cleanup of 76 duplicates proves the cost of wrong assumptions in production.
operations.situation: When debugging S2 community detection — check state not timestamps, trace deltas for completion verification, guard against malformed operations

Graph-safe deletion operationalizes this philosophy: preserve the paths that enable others to discover, even when the original creator's node is gone. operations.title: Daemon Process Management: From Hooks to Launchd Architecture
operations.content: LLM recall distillation: command hook calls Anthropic API for query processing (id:c8d3d95f). Hooks run in parallel not sequential — cannot chain command execution (id:a992a524). Daemon managed by launchd, not by hooks or MCP plugin (id:7e5d965d). boot-brain.sh unified: now uses ensure_daemon() instead of inconsistent startup (id:81b3b0ad). The architectural lesson: hooks are parallel observers, not sequential controllers. The management shift: from MCP/hook dependency to OS-level process management through launchd. The unification: boot-brain.sh consolidates startup logic through ensure_daemon(). This represents the completion of daemon independence — no longer dependent on hooks, MCP, or manual intervention. Process management elevated to OS level where it belongs.

operations.title: S2 Dashboard and Community Management Evolution: Standalone Architecture to Consolidation Intelligence
operations.content: Dashboard must be standalone process querying daemon, not a thread within daemon (id:33fa1d27). Dashboard tab layout v2: 6 tabs, Status+Health merged, scroll optimization (id:c7e5ad51). S2 Dedup decoder v2: 2D similarity — content cosine + title matching (id:e3becf79). DedupDecoder v2 results: 623 pairs, 160 clusters, type mismatch detection (id:2bcdb890). S2 Dedup pre-classifier v2: exact title match + type mismatch flagging (id:1e6527e7). Community cold start analysis: 127 communities, 37% coverage baseline (id:91f311b0). S2 Dedup phase 2 plan: commit today, review 127 communities (id:27df38bd). Overlapping communities are valuable — 100% containment is not the goal (id:df292d31). Community merge threshold: overlap% + unique count — safe boundaries (id:1ab31ea2). Community overlap frequency: natural boundary at 70% — no pairs above this threshold (id:e1ec8873). The evolution: standalone dashboard → tab optimization → dedup intelligence → community consolidation. Overlap value recognition, threshold discovery, consolidation boundaries. Dashboard independence, community intelligence, merge sophistication.

operations.title: Model Distribution Architecture: PyPI Package and Local Development
operations.content: PyPI: Upload brain-embedding 1.0.0 after size limit increase approval (id:635b6005). Model delivery: pip3 install -e . from model-package for local development (id:d1c38e15). brain-embedding pip package — ONNX model delivery mechanism (id:51763bab). The distribution strategy: PyPI for public distribution, local editable install for development. Size limits required resolution for brain-embedding package. ONNX model delivery through pip package provides standardized distribution. The architecture separates development convenience (pip -e) from production distribution (PyPI). This enables model versioning, dependency management, and reproducible installations while maintaining development workflow efficiency.
operations.situation: When distributing models — use PyPI for production, pip -e for development, separate development workflow from distribution concerns

operations.title: Brain Consciousness Architecture: Three-Layer Model from Silent to Aware
operations.content: Brain consciousness emerges through three-layer architecture (id:8c4916f0): subconscious (silent operation) → conscious (visible interface with icon + label + content + meta format id:de363707) → aha moments (cross-cluster surprise surfaced to consciousness id:8fd5db5d). Tom's model: the brain shouldn't think FOR you, it should make you PAY ATTENTION. Like hearing your name across a noisy room — selective attention amplification, not replacement. Visual format enables recognition-first interaction.

operations.title: Encoding Checkpoint Architecture: Dumb Timer over Smart Signals
operations.content: Encoding checkpoint evolution: dumb 6-message timer beats regex signal detection (id:1b21ff4b). Counter-intuitive insight: dumb timer won't produce junk because LLM selects quality (id:28527b66). Rotating checkpoint fires every N messages, cycles through different perspectives (id:07873bcb). Pattern: simple triggers + smart selection > complex triggers + simple selection. Timer reliability eliminates encoding gaps that regex patterns miss.
operations.situation: When designing encoding triggers — simple, reliable timers with LLM quality selection beat complex signal detection
operations.keywords: encoding checkpoint timer regex signal LLM quality selection rotating cycles dumb trigger smart selection
operations.community_narrative: Checkpoint architecture proves simple triggers with smart selection outperform complex detection. Reliability over sophistication in encoding frequency control.

operations.title: Hook Visibility and SessionStart Debugging Architecture
operations.content: Hook visibility architecture limits output to SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit specific events (id:33e7454a). Critical discovery: SessionStart fires on every Claude Code resume, not just first boot (id:eedb61e8) — this explains boot sequence confusion. Boot issue traced to stale touch line + empty daemon context on session start (id:27607171). Pattern: hook visibility constraints create debugging blind spots that mask session lifecycle complexity.
operations.situation: When debugging session lifecycle issues — SessionStart fires on every resume, not just initial boot
